_note: Codex/OMX process identities. recognizes() classifies one process by its own comm + argv, so a codex/omx process is recognized whether or not it runs under an srt/bwrap sandbox — the wrapper is a separate ancestor process whose own identity does not match, so it belongs in noMatch. Finding the codex process inside a wrapped tree is the process walker's job (hasCodexDescendant), not the recognizer's. Match/no-match cases mirror processes.test.ts.

match.name: node launcher used by current Codex installs
codex reported directly as the process comm
omx worker shares the codex kind

noMatch.name: OMX HUD watcher is not an agent
srt sandbox wrapper (ancestor, not the agent)
bwrap sandbox wrapper (ancestor, not the agent)
